description: A/B test significance calculator — A/B test calculator for conversion rates: two-proportion z-test p-value, significance at your confidence level, absolute and relative lift with confidence interval, Wilson intervals per variant, Bayesian probability that B beats A, achieved power, visitors needed per variant (for the observed lift or a target mde=), and a sample-ratio-mismatch check. Verdict B_WINS / A_WINS / NO_SIGNIFICANT_DIFFERENCE / NEED_MORE_DATA / SAMPLE_RATIO_MISMATCH. Params: a_visitors, a_conversions, b_visitors, b_conversions (required); optional confidence= (default 95), tails=1|2, power= (default 80), mde= relative % lift, split= expected % of traffic to A (default 50). Offline. Price: $0.002 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: business_ab_test
